cycles.method: static: tools/build/cycle_count.py on a scratch remix carrying RING_SC (63 cycles/sample, the worst of the two straight-line mode loops, DUCK 63 and RING 63, with its bsr counted). measured: modules/ring-sc/perf.py bench, benchmark_reverbs.run as benchmark_stock_dsp.py runs it (one instance per core at positions 0 and 4, audio at X:0, 4,096 blocks of 16 frames, the null stub's peak subtracted) on a private native image a3c9b043... with the key bus's seed marks written into both payloads' dumps (as the base's tap leaves them, so the dear path runs): worst of 70 RINGMOD SC cases, the manifest's dearest settings in DUCK with a trig split at frame 1, 80.56 executed instructions/sample (67.69 unsplit, as 0.1.0); RING with SLEW and RECT at 127 and S&H at its shortest period 79.19 with splits, 67.00 unsplit (0.1.0's RING 38.06 / 30.94). Executed instructions in dsp_host, not chip cycles. Not in these figures: the base's key bus tap, charged to RINGMOD SC on both cores while it is installed, 41 executed instructions a sample a core for the four tracks (counted from its source, dsp-sites.json), charged at 7/4.

stock.baseline: perf.py bench: COMPRESSOR, SPRING REV, DARK REV and DJ EQ on the original image through the same cases as RINGMOD SC (fixed, the moving pattern and a trig split at every position 1-15); unsplit they reproduce benchmark_stock_dsp.py's out/stock_dsp_bench figures from the same session (COMPRESSOR 67.4, SPRING REV 257.5, DARK REV 193.2, DJ EQ 293.4).
stock.justification: RINGMOD SC's worst case with trig splits, 80.56 (DUCK, unchanged from 0.1.0; RING's carrier stages stay under it at 79.19), is 1.12x COMPRESSOR's (72.06), the stock dynamics effect closest in function, and a quarter of SPRING REV's 314.19, the cost target for new FX. With the key bus's tap (41 a core, shared by every instance on that core) the module's footprint on a core with one instance is about 122 executed instructions a sample, still under half of SPRING REV.

stress.method: modules/ring-sc/perf.py stress --both, the load stress_project.py describes driven straight into dsp_host on the private native image a3c9b043... (key bus seed marks written into both payloads' dumps): RINGMOD SC on FX1 and FX2 of all eight tracks, eight instances a core; per block three LFOs (sine, triangle, square) on each instance's DPTH, KLPF and REL (RECT in RING), and a new random value on every slot of both instances each sixteenth at 120 BPM: 14 slots changed per step and track (KEY and MODE included, so keys, modes and RING's SLEW, S&H and RECT switch under load); trig splits of 3, 8, 15, 1, 7 and 12 frames on six tracks; eight different 32 s stems plus a 2 s tail; dsp_host -guard 0x4000 -guard-shared -dirty 0x5a. Result: host exit 0, no hang; 16 guarded instances, 0 stray write regions and 0 clobbers; per-core peak 638.1 and 636.8 executed instructions/sample with all sixteen. The DSP side only: the firmware's own LFO and lock delivery, Part switches and the key bus's tap (not in a dsp_host image) are not in it.
